name: Crime Reaches Breaking Point
description: The Crime in %LOCATION_NAME has reached a tipping point. Criminals and Mobs terrorize the streets, unopposed by the ruling soveriegn. In the chaos, perhaps an opportunity can be gained from this...

choices.name: Criminals Damage Prosperity
choices.description: In the chaos, the city's prosperity has suffered. Crime temporarily reduces Prosperity by an extra 35% and is reduced by 100%.

choices.name: Embed Criminals
choices.description: The Lawbreaker organizes the criminals to infiltrate this location's administration, reducing security by an extra 4 while the crime modifier is present (can stack).

choices.name: Empty Treasury
choices.description:
The criminals are manipulated into stealing all the gold from this locations treasury plus 100 gold, and then leaving it in a cache. Crime is reduced by 100%.

[Requires 100% infiltration]

choices.name: Increase Unrest
choices.description: Increases UNREST by 100. Crime is Reduced by 100%.
